meaning_en: to cast molten metal / smelt unadulterated ingots

past.ar: سَبَكَ المَعْدِنِيُّ الفِضَّةَ النَّقِيَّةَ فِي القَالَبِ
past.de: Der Metaller goss das reine Silber in die Form
past.en: The metallurgist cast pure silver into the mold

present.de: Er gießt die Barren nach streng genormtem Feingehalt
present.en: He casts ingots to a certified accurate standard

imperative.ar: اسْبُكْ بَعْدَ تَخْلِيصِ المَعْدِنِ مِنَ الشَّوَائِبِ
imperative.en: Cast only after purifying the melt of all dross!
